6.248 rsInvalidRepeatOnNewPageOnColumnTablixMember
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidRepeatOnNewPageOnColumnTablixMember is a critical error that will occur when a
TablixMember instance within the Tablix.TablixColumnHierarchy has TablixMember.RepeatOnNewPage
set to a value that is not false.
